title: See Financial Data OFF makes Invoicing & payments inaccessible even with View, Create & Edit and Delete
custom_preconds: 1. A user has a role with Invoicing & payments View, Create & Edit and Delete but See Financial Data OFF.
custom_steps:
1. Log in and open a work order.
  2. Look for the Finance tab.
  3. Look for any invoicing option on the work order or a part sale.
custom_expected:
The Finance tab is not shown.

There are no invoicing options.

Invoicing & payments is inaccessible because See Financial Data is off (it overrides the permissions).
evidence: UI/editor: See Financial Data OFF makes Invoicing & payments inaccessible — SFD-off roles (e.g. Technician) show no Finance tab on the WO, and the editor forces SFD ON before Invoicing can be enabled (C26471/C26474). Invoicing is unreachable without SFD even with View/C&E/Delete.
